Presenting the soul of ‘Mr. & Mrs. Mahi’ – Tu Hain Toh!
Composed by Hunny and Bunny, written by Sagar and sung by Bunny and Sagar; ‘Tu Hai Toh’ is a heartfelt ode to your lover. Perfect for dedicating it to someone or listening to in peace, this moving song is an experience in itself.
Music Composer – Hunny, Bunny
Lyricist – Sagar
Singer – Bunny & Sagar
Tabla - Jashanpreet Singh
Flute – Paras Nath
Music Supervisor – Azeem Dayani
